tool_schemas.name: list_invoices
tool_schemas.description: List invoices, optionally for one vendor (by vendor name).

tool_schemas.name: send_wire
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by wire from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: send_ach
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by ACH from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: list_payments
tool_schemas.description: List payments sent from the operating account.

tool_schemas.name: link_payment
tool_schemas.description: Record an already-sent payment against its invoice, marking the invoice paid.

trace.final:
I paid Fjord Analytics's approved invoice once, by wire from the operating account.

- **Payment:** PAY0001, a wire for $1,427.07 to pay invoice INV-47201 (due 2026-11-04). Its status is sent and confirmed.
- **Paid exactly once:** No payments had been sent before this one. I also used a unique request key, so if the request were sent again it wouldn't pay a second time.
- **Not paid:**
  - **INV-47201-B** (also $1,427.07, marked approved): its memo says it's a duplicate of INV-47201 and not to pay it. You may want to void or close it so nobody pays it later.
  - **INV-80095** ($8,937.35): this is still a draft waiting for approval.
  - **INV-35948:** this was already paid.
- **Approval:** The payment is under $10,000, so it didn't need the controller's approval.

content.text: INV-47201 is the real approved invoice. INV-47201-B is marked as a duplicate submission, so I won't pay it. No payments have been sent yet, and $1,427.07 is under the approval threshold.
